sources.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: render-locked four-view architectural construction board for a CityPrompt LEGO building variant
Primary request: Design one coherent, physically buildable Aquatic Natatorium - Parametric Wave Shell from the catalogue contract below and show that exact same building in four equal panels in a precise 2 by 2 grid.
Panel 1: dead-front orthographic elevation, complete building visible. Panel 2: pedestrian-height front-right architectural survey oblique. Panel 3: rear-left oblique proving every material and structural system wraps the secondary elevations. Panel 4: high aerial roof-plan oblique proving roof topology, courts, spans, and equipment.
Catalogue contract: A broad public natatorium is enclosed by a continuous asymmetric wave shell whose translucent silver polycarbonate crest lifts above a full-height glazed gable; branching concrete struts, twin cable masts, roof ribs, and a visible blue pool hall form one credible long-span structure.
Building lock: 82 m by 56 m, two occupied public levels; one smooth asymmetric wave roof spans the pool hall, its high crest and low eaves remain continuous through front, rear and sides, diagonal concrete struts meet real roof nodes, twin masts carry visible stays, and the glazed gable reveals the pool rather than an opaque room card.
Scene/backdrop: clean warm-light-grey architectural studio ground and backdrop, no neighbors, trees, cars or people.
Style/medium: premium photoreal architectural survey photography and physically plausible construction reference, not concept art.
Lighting/mood: neutral bright overcast survey illumination with soft contact shadows and controlled glass reflections, consistent in every panel.
Materials/textures: translucent platinum polycarbonate roof panels; cool board-formed concrete plinth and branching struts; stainless cable stays; silver aluminum pressure caps; neutral low-iron pool-hall glass; occupied aquatic-hall depth with blue water and warm soffits; pale standing-seam service roof.
Constraints: exact same coherent building topology, storey datums, structural bays, openings, entrances, material zones and roof in all four panels; credible load paths; real recessed openings and physical screens; thin neutral gutters; whole building in every frame; no labels, text, signs, logos or watermark.
Avoid: rectangular sports box, repeated sawtooth sheds, disconnected roof shards, opaque blue window wall, unsupported wave canopy, fantasy waterpark, generic barrel vault; perspective distortion, blank sides, changed geometry between panels, entourage, dramatic sunset.

Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: shadow-neutral 3 by 2 construction and occupied-depth material board for the exact Aquatic Natatorium - Parametric Wave Shell shown in Image 1
Input images: Image 1 is the approved four-view geometry, palette, construction-scale and optical authority.
Primary request: Create six equal square straight-on orthographic samples in a precise 3-column by 2-row grid separated only by thin neutral-grey gutters, with no labels.
Top-left: platinum translucent polycarbonate standing panels, authentic construction scale and fine micro-detail, no facade or opening.
Top-center: cool board-formed architectural concrete, authentic construction scale and fine micro-detail, no complete building element.
Top-right: stainless cable and node hardware, authentic construction scale and fine micro-detail, no complete ornament assembly.
Bottom-left: silver aluminum curtain-wall pressure cap, authentic construction scale and fine micro-detail, no complete frame, door or screen.
Bottom-center: neutral low-iron aquatic hall glass plus clean occupied depth seen dead-on, with clear floor, ceiling and restrained warm occupation, no exterior frame, mullion, screen, facade or skewed perspective.
Bottom-right: pale silver service metal and translucent crest, authentic construction scale and evenly lit, no complete roof scene.
Scene/backdrop: flat evenly lit material-capture setup. Style/medium: premium physically based photoreal architectural construction texture reference.
Lighting: diffuse neutral overcast capture; no directional sunlight, baked shadow, vignette or perspective.
Constraints: exact 3 by 2 grid; every sample fills its cell edge-to-edge; no labels, text, logos or watermark; no complete facade or repeated window grid; match Image 1 exactly.
Avoid: cartoon materials, generic substitutions, oversized motifs, blue mirror glass, dramatic lighting, building perspective, decorative border.
